_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check_health_endpoint_semantics.py (Car 0091). Governance mirrors .route-literal-allowlist.json: rationale >= 40 chars, and a STALE entry (a site that no longer probes bare /health) hard-fails. DO NOT add a site here just to silence the guard: only readiness that is GENUINELY required (a db/embed payload field is read, a DB write is gated, or the target service exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all) belongs here. A site whose caller only needs 'is the process up' is a bug — switch it to /health/live instead of allowlisting it.

yadgar/backend/embed_service/embed_servi.rationale: The embed service's OWN /health handler probing its SurrealDB dependency to decide its own readiness. SurrealDB exposes no /health/live variant; this IS the readiness check being implemented, not a caller of one.

yadgar/core/bootstrap/backend_ready.py:9.rationale: Car 0027c's core startup gate probes the BACKEND embed service, which exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all — ADR-0019's liveness split is scoped to the core daemon only. Readiness is also what is genuinely required here: the very next thing the core does is StorageEngine.__init__ -> _init_schema(), which issues DDL over HTTP, so the gate must know db_ok and engine_loaded, not merely that a process bound a port.

yadgar/core/cli/seed.py:59.rationale: Gates a POST to /hooks/seed-anchor, which writes to the DB. Genuinely needs readiness (db actually connected and usable), not just process-up liveness, before attempting the write.

yadgar/core/cli/version.py:32.rationale: `yadgar version` CLI command displays db/embed/uptime fields from the readiness payload to the operator. /health/live's payload lacks those fields, so readiness is required here.

yadgar/core/daemon/daemon.py:414.rationale: YadgarDaemon.status() CLI command reports full db/model/drainer detail to the operator (including the degraded-detail body on 503). This genuinely needs the readiness payload, not liveness.

yadgar/core/daemon/daemon.py:705.rationale: _embed_health_ok probes the backend embed service (port 8001), which exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all — ADR-0019's liveness split is scoped to the core daemon only.

yadgar/core/server/http.py:458.rationale: This is core's own /health readiness handler (_probe_dependency) probing a dependency (db or embed) to build the readiness payload. It IS the readiness implementation, not a caller needing liveness.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:218.rationale: _assert_backend_quiesced verifies NOTHING answers the backend's port before a swap (data-safety gate against the 2026-06-16 vacuum incident). Any HTTP answer at all is the failure signal; backend has no /health/live.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:239.rationale: _wait_for_health polls the SurrealDB backend (not core), which exposes no /health/live liveness variant — the backend readiness endpoint is the only probe available for this wait.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:258.rationale: _wait_for_yadgar_health gates vacuum finalize on the core actually being able to serve from the swapped-in DB before check_invariants runs — a data-safety hard gate that genuinely needs readiness (db connected), not just process-up liveness.

yadgar/core/vacuum/launcher.py:321.rationale: Belt-and-suspenders poll confirming the side backend's port was actually released after SIGTERM before the swap proceeds. The side backend (SurrealDB) has no /health/live variant to probe instead.

yadgar/core/vacuum/__init__.py:1239.rationale: _check_backend_reachable preflight-checks the SurrealDB backend is up before vacuum starts. Backend has no /health/live variant; readiness is the only probe available for this dependency.

yadgar/core/daemon/units.py:283.rationale: task:0105's docker readiness gate for the BACKEND embed service (port 8001), which exposes no /health/live liveness variant at all — ADR-0019's liveness split is scoped to the core daemon only. Identical reasoning to daemon.py:705's _embed_health_ok.

yadgar/core/daemon/units.py:410.rationale: task:0105's docker readiness gate for the CORE unit, standing in for podman's sd_notify proxy, which docker does not have. It must approximate READY=1 — emitted LAST, after the full engine set (bootstrap.py). /health/live goes green as soon as the HTTP server binds, so gating on liveness would mark the docker unit active EARLIER than the podman arm does, a semantic regression. Readiness is genuinely required.
